claim.claim-text: 1. A sole structure for an article of footwear, the sole structure comprising:

a fluid-filled bladder including a first segment extending along a medial side of the sole structure, a second segment extending along a lateral side of the sole structure, and a first conduit extending between and fluidly coupling the first segment and the second segment; and a cushioning member including a pocket having a first recess extending along the medial side of the sole structure and receiving the first segment of the fluid-filled bladder, a second recess extending along the lateral side of the sole structure and receiving the second segment of the fluid-filled bladder, and a first channel extending between the first recess and the second recess and receiving the first conduit of the fluid-filled bladder.
2. The sole structure of Claim 1, wherein the cushioning member comprises a polymer foam material.
3. The sole structure of Claim 1, wherein the fluid-filled bladder includes a second conduit extending between and fluidly coupling the first segment and the second segment.
4. The sole structure of Claim 3, wherein the second conduit is spaced apart from the first conduit along a length of the sole structure.

5. The sole structure of Claim 4, wherein the cushioning member includes a second channel extending between the first recess and the second recess and receives the second conduit of the fluid-filled bladder.
6. The sole structure of Claim 5, wherein the cushioning member includes a projection extending between the first channel and the second channel.

7. The sole structure of Claim 6, wherein the projection includes a distal end in contact with a web area of the fluid-filled bladder, the web area extending between and separating the first segment of the fluid-filled bladder and the second segment of the fluid-filled bladder.

8. The sole structure of Claim 1, wherein the first segment of the fluid-filled bladder extends along a first longitudinal axis and the second segment of the fluid-filled bladder extends along a second longitudinal axis, the first longitudinal axis being convergent with the second longitudinal axis.

9. The sole structure of Claim 1, wherein the first recess extends along a first longitudinal axis and the second recess extends along a second longitudinal axis, the first longitudinal axis being convergent with the second longitudinal axis.

10. The sole structure of Claim 1, wherein the first segment of the fluid-filled bladder and the second segment of the fluid-filled bladder converge in a direction from a heel region of the sole structure to a forefoot region of the sole structure.

11. The sole structure of Claim 10, wherein the first recess of the cushioning member and the second recess of the cushioning member converge in a direction from the heel region of the sole structure to the forefoot region of the sole structure.

12. The sole structure of Claim 1, wherein the first recess of the cushioning member and the second recess of the cushioning member converge in a direction from a heel region of the sole structure to a forefoot region of the sole structure.
13. The sole structure of Claim 1, wherein:

(i) the first segment of the fluid-filled bladder is exposed at the medial side of the sole structure and/or (ii) wherein the second segment of the fluid-filled bladder is exposed at the lateral side of the sole structure.
14. The sole structure of Claim 1, further comprising:

(i) a first outsole attached to the first segment of the fluid-filled bladder on an opposite side of the first segment than the first recess, the first outsole defining a first ground-contacting surface of the sole structure and/or (ii) a second outsole attached to the second segment of the fluid-filled bladder on an opposite side of the second segment than the second recess, the second outsole defining a second ground-contacting surface of the sole structure.
15. An article of footwear incorporating the sole structure of Claim 1.
